Innovación que nunca para
En Honeywell Cable, sabemos que nuestros clientes exigen
innovación, y se la merecen.
Esto es lo que nos impulsa a trabajar siempre para mejorar nuestros productos y servicios. Nuestro objetivo es claro:
ofrecer los productos más confiables, las instalaciones más simples y la asistencia más rigurosa.
Estas son apenas algunas de las formas en que hemos respondido recientemente con nueva
tecnología innovadora:
Cables de categoría: en respuesta a las exigencias de un mayor ancho de banda y seguridad, hemos completado nuestra
línea de cables de categoría de red para satisfacer las necesidades tecnológicas del presente y el futuro:
• Cat 6A: para el ancho de banda máximo capaz de soportar exigencias de 10G y 7G inalámbrica.
• Alternativas Cat 5e/6 Plus con protector: para aplicaciones de datos cada vez más grandes y sensibles.

Conectados para el éxito
El cable de la serie Genesis® de Honeywell
satisface una amplia variedad de necesidades
de alimentación de cables de categoría

interrupciones y fortalecer la seguridad general

casi todas las aplicaciones.

secuencial

Cable Listings
Reference Guide
Using unlisted cable is a dangerous decision that can threaten device, personal and environmental
safety. Cable listing marks show that products have been tested to industry-specific fire and safety
standards by unbiased third-party organizations. Choosing listed cable will protect your cable
investment – preventing rip outs, reinstallations and fire hazards.
Reputable Testing Partners
The two most recognized testing entities are UL and ETL. Both are certified as
Nationally Recognized Testing Laboratories (NRTL), giving them the authority
to test and certify products to widely accepted safety requirements.
Though different organizations, UL and ETL test to the same standards for any given listing
and a listing from either organization has identical meaning.

Cable Intelligence Series
Flame Testing
Because choosing the wrong cable is a safety hazard, flame tests are
designed to simulate cable performance in various environments.
General Purpose testing is the least stringent, but ensures cable does not allow
flames to spread more than eight feet. For this reason, General Purpose cable may
not be installed as a substitution for Riser or Plenum cable.
Riser testing is conducted within a ventilated environment, with the cable arranged
vertically. To achieve a riser rating, cable cannot allow the flame to propagate between
stories. Because this is more demanding than General Purpose testing, Riser rated
cable can be used in place of General Purpose cable, but not in place of Plenum.
Plenum testing is conducted with the cable in a horizontal arrangement – again,
within a ventilated environment. To receive a plenum rating, cable must produce

fragmentos.doc: Cable Ratings and Substitutions
fragmentos.titulo: Cable Ratings and Substitutions
fragmentos.texto:
in a horizontal arrangement – again,
within a ventilated environment. To receive a plenum rating, cable must produce
a low volume of smoke and maintain adequate flame-resistance in ducts, plenums
and other spaces used for environmental air. This is the most stringent test, so cable
with a Plenum rating can be used in place of both Riser and General Purpose cable,
but Riser or General Purpose cable cannot be used in place of Plenum cable.
Dangerous Consequences
If the wrong cable is installed, damage can be severe, leading to significant monetary loss, legal ramifications,
ruined reputations and in some cases, loss of human life. By installing the appropriate cable, these damages
can be avoided.
Although some dealers and contractors only install Plenum cable to ensure safety, this is not always possible,
practical or cost-effective.
